candidate_workaround: Separate repository-wide status from constant-time branch and head probes and give the status process a measured bounded budget that includes shell startup overhead.
failure_signature: A combined status branch and head shell wrapper returned exit 124 after ten seconds without usable output.
recurrence_guard: Do not bundle repository-wide status with independent identity probes under a ten-second wrapper; measure status separately and retain timeout evidence.
rollback: Treat the combined wrapper as failed, perform no mutation, and rerun branch, head, and status as separate read-only probes.
scope_boundary: Owner-local Git inspection latency only; not remote equality, repository correctness, production performance, or independent reproduction.
title: Separate repository-wide status from constant-time identity probes
